tools.name: documentdb_list_databases
tools.description: List all databases on the cluster. If db_name is provided, return that database collections with estimated document counts.

tools.name: documentdb_drop_database
tools.description: Drop a database and all its collections. Requires confirm_db_name to exactly equal db_name.

tools.name: documentdb_drop_collection
tools.description: Drop a collection from a database. Requires confirm_collection_name to exactly equal collection_name.

tools.name: documentdb_rename_collection
tools.description: Rename a collection

tools.name: documentdb_sample_documents
tools.description: Retrieve sample documents from a collection. Useful for understanding data schema and query generation.

tools.name: documentdb_current_ops
tools.description: Get information about current MongoDB operations

tools.name: documentdb_get_statistics
tools.description: Unified statistics tool. scope=database returns db.stats(); scope=collection returns collStats; scope=index returns $indexStats usage data.

tools.name: documentdb_find_documents
tools.description: Find documents in a collection. Supports consolidated options object: limit, skip, sort, projection.

tools.name: documentdb_count_documents
tools.description: Count documents in a collection matching a query

tools.name: documentdb_insert_documents
tools.description: Insert one or more documents. Pass a single document object for insertOne, or an array of documents for insertMany.

tools.name: documentdb_update_documents
tools.description: Update one or more documents in a collection. Set multi=true for updateMany; default false uses updateOne.

tools.name: documentdb_delete_documents
tools.description: Delete one or more documents from a collection. Set multi=true for deleteMany; default false uses deleteOne.

tools.name: documentdb_aggregate
tools.description: Run an aggregation pipeline on a collection

tools.name: documentdb_find_and_modify
tools.description: Find one document and apply an update atomically. Returns the document BEFORE modification, or null if it did not exist.

tools.name: documentdb_explain_operation
tools.description: Explain the execution plan with executionStats verbosity for a find, count, or aggregate operation.

tools.name: documentdb_create_index
tools.description: Create an index on a collection

tools.name: documentdb_list_indexes
tools.description: List all indexes on a collection

tools.name: documentdb_drop_index
tools.description: Drop an index from a collection. Requires confirm_index_name to exactly equal index_name.
